Analysis of this mutation supported the Type 2A phenotype in families with a previously unclassifiable molecular subtype of VHL disease. . . . 20-year-old female referred for cancer genetics consultation due to a personal history of two synchronous primary tumors (a second primary pheochromocytoma and a malignant neuroendocrine tumor of the pancreas) and a family history of early-onset pheochromocytomas. . . . Screening for VHL-associated tumors revealed bilateral retinal HB
